page.overview:
Who is Ace of Hearts?

The woman known as "Ace of Hearts" was a member of the second group to call themselves the Royal Flush Gang. Under orders from Ace of Spades to hunt down the Rogues for a reward, the Ace of Hearts was the one who suggested the plan of kidnapping Golden Glider as leverage.
